d:
BJP March Patna Samrat Choudhary : rajdhani patna men BJP ki or se 'loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao' march nikala gaya. is march men bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri bhi shamil hue. SIR aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke virodh men kangres ki or se 1 navanbar ko prastavit raili ke javab men BJP deshbhar men march nikal rahi hai. isi kram men patna men bhi march ka aayojan kiya gaya.
Is riport men dekhie patna men BJP ke march ki tasviren aur bihar ki rajniti se juri puri khabra.
